method: Every item of all 58 test examples read by Claude (model-assisted review), with attention to items tagged verb_shortcut_misleads / verb_multi_level_in_train and to the five adjacent-level contrasts per example. Not human-verified.

contested_gold_label.213-source: Labelled Analyze, but the task (determine which overridden method executes for a superclass reference) is tracing a known rule on a supplied program, i.e. Apply; it is the same demand as 213-Apply.
contested_gold_label.213-Apply: Same demand as the 213 source; the Apply/Analyze contrast for 213 is not valid until the source label is resolved.
contested_gold_label.570-source: Labelled Analyze, but the task (service order of SCAN for stated requests) is executing the algorithm, i.e. Apply; same demand as 570-Apply.
contested_gold_label.570-Apply: Same demand as the 570 source; contrast invalid until resolved.

weak_distinction_kept.520-Understand: Describing how x=5 and x=-3 exercise the branches is close to computing the coverage in 520-Apply; kept because one explains and one quantifies.
weak_distinction_kept.474-Understand: Explaining how the 8-line mapping places blocks 5, 13, 21, 6 is close to computing the indices in 474-Apply.
weak_distinction_kept.472-Understand: Interpreting the zero-NPV discount rate borders on computing the IRR (472-Apply).
weak_distinction_kept.306-source: Label-only example; source, Analyze and Evaluate rows are generic about the supplied layout.
weak_distinction_kept.118-Create: States the correct 6 ns access time, which answers 118-Apply and exposes the false claim in 118-Evaluate; acceptable for label prediction, not for answer scoring across rows of one example.

fixed_in_pass_3_1.342-Understand: too close to the Analyze row

misleading_verb_items_assessment: Of the items tagged verb_shortcut_misleads before the fixes, all but the 213/570 Apply rows carry correct gold labels: the leading verb points elsewhere but the demanded operation matches the label (e.g. 'Classify ... under IaaS/PaaS/SaaS' is Understand-classifying; 'Find the production conflicts ... and trace each' is Analyze; 'Find a closed-form formula ... and prove it' is Create).
limitations: Only a few items per slice (about 20-50); per-slice accuracy has wide uncertainty.
Only 1 of 406 adjacent-level pairs shares its leading verb, so the pairs mostly test content cues rather than verb-held-constant contrasts.
